guide.title: How to Use
guide.step1: Choose the interface language at top-right (Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean).
guide.step2: Optional: enter an Encryption Key (e.g., 123). The key shuffles the emoji map so only people with the same key can decrypt.
guide.step3: Enter your text (supports CJK and Latin letters; punctuation optional).
guide.step4: Click “Encrypt to Emojis” to encrypt; click “Decrypt to Text” to restore.
guide.step5: Share the result and the same key with your friend; otherwise decryption will fail.

about.title: Changyou Circle • Emoji Cipher Translator
paragraphs: Want to send small secrets in chats without others noticing? Want to make ordinary messages playful? This tool turns your text into a string of emojis. Anyone who receives the emoji string can paste it here to get the original text — using emojis as a ‘cipher’ for chatting.

It’s dead simple: open the site, type your text, pick a language, tap Encrypt — text becomes an emoji string. Got an emoji cipher from a friend? Paste it and tap Decrypt to restore the text. No learning curve — even first‑timers get it in one try.
We support 8 languages (Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Korean, Japanese, plus German, French, Spanish). Use emoji ciphers across languages without worry.

The most useful part is the private key. It’s like adding a lock to your emoji cipher. After you set a key, only people who know the same key can decrypt to the original text. From sharing secrets and personal greetings to sensitive work notes or cross‑border chats, this gives you peace of mind.
No signup, no login — just type, choose language, (optionally) set a key, and encrypt. It takes half a minute and fits both fun and practical use.

Unlike ordinary emoji generators, this balances fun and security. It keeps chatting lively while enabling encrypted communication and multi‑language support. Send ‘ciphers’ with emojis and guard privacy with your key — a fresh way to chat.

Whether you want more fun in daily chats, playful ‘cipher’ interactions with friends, private communication, or frequent chats with overseas friends, this translator helps. Hide text in emojis and keep privacy safe with a simple flow.

quickStart.title: Quick Start

step1.title: Language & Theme
step1.text: Change language at top-right; moon/sun for dark/light.

step2.title: Enter Text
step2.text: Paste or type in “Input Text”. CJK, Latin letters, numbers and punctuation supported.

step3.title: Key (optional)
step3.text: Enter an Encryption Key under “Advanced Settings” for extra privacy.

step5.title: Copy / Import / Export
step5.text: Use “Copy Result”; “Import File” supports TXT/MD; export TXT/PNG.

step6.title: Share & QR
step6.text: Click “Share” to generate a link and QR; when exporting an image, you can choose to include a visible QR code.

quickStart.tip: Tip: Include the QR code if you want others to scan it easily.

emojiInput.title: Emoji Input
emojiInput.mac: macOS: Ctrl + Cmd + Space opens the emoji panel.
emojiInput.ios: iPhone/iPad: Switch to the Emoji keyboard; long‑press for variants.
emojiInput.android: Android: Open the Emoji panel on the keyboard.
emojiInput.tip: You can also click “Reuse” on our page to put history back into input.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1:
Q: I don't see text after encrypting?
The result appears in the output area; use “Swap Text” to move it back to input.
faq.q2:
Q: How do I decrypt from an exported image?
If the image includes a visible QR, scan it. Otherwise copy the text from the image back here to decrypt.
faq.q3:
Q: Is multi-language failure a bug?
No. As long as Encrypt→Decrypt restores the original text, it’s fine.
